rules.fill: FILL = Main recommended side, not written
rules.hold: HOLD/BOARD = full slate game with no Main side (pinned under CLEAR/FILL per sport)
rules.owner: Bet Bot Main owns the card; Sports Betting shops + exports
rules.props: Separate NFL Props tab: up to 4 ranked props per NFL game from nfl_game_props_*.json. CFB props off. Not under Board cards.
rules.board_probs: MODEL% (+ MARKET% when available) on every MLB/CFB/NFL board game from Main/Sim feeds — never invent.
rules.ledger: Ledger = Main written CLEAR grades only (settled + open from ledger_feed). Shadow (paper) is a separate section — NOT bankroll / NOT CLEARs.
rules.probs: model%/market% from feed when present; else fair vs mkt lines in Main notes via 16σ CFB / 13.86σ NFL normal CDF; market% falls back to assume -110 when no price. Never invent fair lines.
